subject: science
concept: Understanding cells as the basic unit of life
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student examines a real or virtual microscope image of cells and identifies visible structures
exercise.pictorial: Student labels the basic parts of a cell diagram (membrane, nucleus, cytoplasm)
exercise.abstract: Student explains why the cell is considered the basic unit of life

misconception_flags: believes cells are only found in animals, missing that plants and other organisms are also made of cells

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
